narrationTexts: I'll look at the project first.
Bug: `orderTotal` taxes pre-discount base. Comment says tax the discounted amount; code uses `cents`.
finalText:
Green. 625/625 passing.

Only 3 real failures in that wall of text, all one bug in `src/pricing.js:41` (`orderTotal`): tax computed on pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount — so discounted orders with nonzero tax came out high. Other 622 cases passed because they had tax 0 or no discount, which hides the difference.

```js
const tax = roundCents(discounted * taxRate);  // was: cents * taxRate
```

Matches the function's own doc comment ("tax what's actually owed").
